preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in a) and len(set(a)) == n
preconditions.description: The list a contains n distinct integers between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges) and len(set(tuple(sorted(edge)) for edge in edges)) == n - 1
preconditions.description: The list edges contains n-1 distinct edges, each connecting two vertices between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The result is an integer between 0 and 1,000,000,006 inclusive.
The result is calculated as (P * Q - 1) modulo 1000000007, where P and Q are the numerator and denominator of the expected value of the function f(u, v) in its irreducible form.
